meta.raw_data_policy: raw API data lives in git-ignored viral/longform/ and is deleted after 30 days
meta.universe: long (60 s - 30 min), 16:9, public, non-live uploads, last <=150 uploads per channel, from 46 streamer-clip channels; videos must be >=7 days old; compared with the 30 settled long videos posted around each one (15 each side, shifted at the ends, min 10)
meta.outlier_definition: views >= 3x the median views of those neighbours
meta.gate: a pattern counts as 'working' only if rate >= 2x baseline AND n >= 10 coded AND outliers from >= 3 channels
meta.coded_sample: all 460 outliers + 460 random normal videos (seed 11), shuffled; coded titles: 920; coded thumbnails: 288 (random subset by sheet; the rest were not coded after the coding-agent usage limit was hit)
meta.reweighting: coded cells weight sampled normal videos by 1/0.1533 so rates are estimates for the whole population; length, niche, channel, title-regex and Apple Vision cells use all 3,461 videos with no reweighting
